name: AUTOPILOT.OI TikTok Agents Bundle
description_html:
All 3 TikTok agents for Claude. $30 separately, $24 here.

  • Video Agent: scripts, CapCut edit plans, captions and a posting schedule
  • Shop Agent: product research, profit checks, compliant listing drafts, creator outreach drafts
  • Sales Agent: sales video drafts, LIVE scripts, comment and DM reply drafts

What you get: 3 Claude prompt kits (PDFs), each with the master prompt, 5 starter prompts, a 10 minute setup guide and a tracker.

How it works: you run them in Claude Projects. They draft and plan; you edit, post and reply. They don't log into TikTok, edit video or post on their own.

You need: a Claude account (the free plan works, up to 5 Projects).

Education only. Confirm TikTok's current rules and fees in the app. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic or TikTok.
